before.en: Alert interaction, reduced but present urine output and mild dryness may fit monitored oral rehydration when perfusion and drinking ability are adequate. Reduced responsiveness with poor perfusion requires urgent escalation. Bilious vomiting requires urgent evaluation for an alternative serious cause. These are possible findings; the current chart does not document the red flags.
before.zh: 清醒互动、尿量减少但仍有尿，以及轻度干燥，在灌注和饮水能力充分时可符合严密监测下口服补液。反应减弱伴灌注不良需要紧急升级处理。胆汁性呕吐需要紧急评估其他严重病因。这些是可能的表现；当前病历未记录上述危险信号。
